decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Design and Access StatementSite Plan2025/35/012025/35/032025/35/02Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 5 people at any one time acting as a single household and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen / dining rooms shall be retained in perpetuity.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the amenity of neighbours and the residential character of the surrounding area

Within three months of the date of this decision, cycle parking must be provided on site in compliance with the following criteria:provision of five long stay cycle parking spaceslocated in an accessible locaiton: the access route to the store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable a bike to enter, should be step free, and should involve no more than two doors or gates, excluding the store door. Secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob.Fully enclosed, with four walls and a roof.Reason: The Council's Climate Action and Transport Policies seek to increase the use of active and sustainable transport modes. This means that access to bicycle parking should be easy and secure to remove potential barriers to cycling.

Notwithstanding the submitted plans/ documents, within three months of the date of this decision, a detailed plan showing the proposed on-site car parking spaces (3 spaces) and access arrangements to the rear of the site, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details within 2 months of approval. Reason: To ensure adequate on-site car parking for the proposed development and to prevent unacceptable overspill parking on the local road network.

Within three months of the date of this decision, waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site shall be provided within the development, in accordance with Enfields Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities shall be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough wide recycling targets.
